subject: AI Leaders Dinner - Palo Alto - 30 July
text:

subject: Video-Native Curation & Annotation
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded a video surveillance company who moved from in-house
tools, mentioning before they struggled to efficiently filter & select
videos from specific viewpoints, camera types or by quality for edge cases
annotation. So I wonder how you're thinking about this at ECAM, esp. given
the scale and diversity of your deployments?

In case Encord is new to you - we work with Milestone Systems, Flock
Safety, and LVT to ensure dataset representativeness and speed up
annotation with video-native object tracking and event captioning. That's
been key in helping surface actionable events more accurately for human
intervention.

Keen to hear how you're approaching this? Quite flexible Tues to Thurs if
you're open to a chat.

subject: Long tail problem for AV perception data
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded Woven by Toyota, who previously lacked a consistent
way to find rare events across millions of miles of driving data. This led
to duplicated engineering efforts and siloed custom tools being built and
maintained across different teams.

I wonder if that resonates with the challenges you've encountered, esp with
your commercial launch in Atlanta & San Jose on the horizon ?

In case Encord is new to you - we help autonomous driving teams like Woven
improve prediction accuracy in edge cases, enabling them to standardize the
process of searching, filtering and labelling long-tail scenarios as data
requirements constantly evolve.

Keen to hear how you're thinking about this at [COMPANY]. I'm flexible
Tuesdays to Thursdays if you're open to a quick chat.

subject: Congrats on your new role!
text:
Hi [NAME] - congrats on your new position at GetReal! I saw you're working on
the computer vision initiatives there so I wanted to ask for a catch up.

Assuming you're familiar with Encord? We serve as the annotation
infrastructure for facial tracking, segmentation and key point tracking at
Flawless. I'd also like to call out our multimodal curation capabilities,
which could be helpful to structure GetReal's growing volume of audio and
video data.

Curious if you're encountering similar set of problems with your training
data preparation these days at GetReal? I'm flexible Wednesdays and Fridays
if you're open to chat.
